assumptions: Volume state uses calibrated inventory, measured net delivery and reported pump feedback; commands remain separate.
Level mapping uses the declared piecewise-linear calibration and absolute error bound without extrapolation.
Forecasts hold measured deliveries and pump availability constant unless a candidate explicitly changes an eligible control.
Source potential is inferred as measured net delivery plus the frozen commanded curtailment; its future constancy is an assumption.
Redundant readings must have overlapping absolute bounds; the primary value and bound are retained without averaging.

recommendation.explanation: The search evaluated 750 candidate combinations across four available controls (backup_pump flow, bypass flow, truck_route flow, source_a curtailment). The validated run with the lowest modeled cost is run 3753df88, costing 5280 synthetic units. It sets backup_pump flow to 35 m³/h, bypass flow to 18.75 m³/h, truck_route flow to 22 m³/h, and source_a curtailment to 0. All tank volume limits are satisfied with positive headroom (minimum headroom 5.36 m³). The run is validated via native dense reference and is staged for operator review. No other validated run has lower cost. Caveats: the synthetic constant-flow model provides nominal volume feasibility only; quality is not evaluated; finite candidate evaluation does not establish global optimality; request_approval only stages advisory review and requires explicit human action to apply controls.
